text:
Camille: Heads-up  Sales flagged 6 renewal-risk accounts that are blocked by small infra/config issues. Thinking a 50m Renewal Cohort Office Hour (grouped by common blocker) to clear quick wins and produce a per-account "next action" for AEs. Thoughts?
Noah: Sounds good. Keep it short and outcome-driven. Propose 3 x 15m mini-breakouts inside the slot: infra, SDK, tuning.
Rina: I can run the SDK breakout and bring a tiny repro app. Prefer Wed Aug 3 08:00 PT so EU can join midday.
Priya (CS): I'll handle signups + gating: require open ticket id and one-line blocker. Cap each breakout to 6 seats. Will make a Google form.
Camille: Agenda draft:
- 5m intro + goals
- 30m parallel breakouts (3 rooms)
- 10m quick synth + per-account next-action
- 5m publish notes + assignment to AE
Noah: Suggest adding a quick "rollback/fallback" snippet in preread: `--model-fallback=smallest-compatible` so teams can test safe rollback during spikes.
Rina: I'll add SDK repro + common error mappings to preread repo under /enablement/renewal-cohort/
Priya (CS): Form fields: account, ticket id, contact, blocker category (infra/sdk/cost), prefer hands-on (y/n). Posting link in 30m.
enablement-bot: Reminder: upload slides and repro assets to /Enablement/Renewal-Cohort/ before 5pm PT tomorrow or they won't be included in the attendee pack.
ops-bot: Note: for live breakout demo, please do not use customer PII. Use replica dataset or sanitized example.
Camille: Invite blurb draft: "Renewal Cohort Office Hour  50m focused sessions to clear infra/SDK/cost blockers and produce a migration-ready next action for your AE." Keep under 180 chars.
Noah: :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): Form live: https://forms.gle/renew-cohort-abc  internal only. Will share attendee list + assigned breakout room by EOD tomorrow.
Rina: Volunteers to moderate breakouts? react with :raised_hand:
Noah: :raised_hand:
Priya (CS): :raised_hand:
Camille: Great. Action items:
- Priya: form + calendar + Zoom (today)
- Rina: SDK repro + preread (tomorrow)
- Noah: infra rollback snippet + breakout notes (tomorrow)
- Camille: AE invite list + publish internal tracking sheet (tomorrow 10am PT)
Priya (CS): Posting initial RSVP count at noon. Closing thread for major changes  post updates here so we maintain the record.
